info.title: PreciseCapture API
info.description: GIS field data collection platform. Geometry on the wire is GeoJSON in EPSG:4326; errors are RFC 9457 problem JSON; timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC.

get.description: Liveness and readiness: 200 when the database answers, 503 otherwise.
Server discovery document (also served at the site root, RFC 8615 style).

post.description:
Password login with an email or phone identifier.

Returns a 15 minute access JWT and a 30 day rotating refresh token.
Rotate a refresh token. Reusing an already rotated token revokes the whole chain.
Revoke the refresh token chain. Idempotent.
Send a one-time code by SMS or email. The reply never reveals whether the account exists.
Exchange a one-time code for tokens. 5 wrong attempts invalidate the code.

post.description: Register (or update) this device. Send the client-generated UUIDv7 as `id`.

patch.description: Owners and admins may change name, slug, country and settings (incl. capture defaults).

delete.description: Admins remove members; any member may remove themselves (except the last owner).

get.description:
Everything a phone needs offline. ETag = hash(config_version, membership version, project
role); If-None-Match gives 304. The server_seq watermark travels in X-Server-Seq (0 until M6).
